Boeing 737 MAX MCAS crashes (Lion Air 610, Ethiopian 302)
incidents.observation_boundary: The MCAS design/certification failure and the two 737 MAX accidents plus the between-crash period; excludes broader 737 MAX issues unrelated to MCAS.

incidents.observation_boundary: The childcare-benefit fraud risk-classification system and its safeguards (~2013-2020) and resulting harms; excludes the separate FSV blacklist.

incidents.title: Microsoft Tay chatbot manipulated into abusive output
Clearview AI non-consensual facial-recognition scraping
incidents.observation_boundary: Clearview's non-consensual scraping of billions of facial images (~2017 onward) and 2021-2022 regulatory findings; excludes post-2022 appeals.

incidents.title: UK Ofqual A-level grading algorithm and its withdrawal
incidents.observation_boundary: The 2020 England A-level/GCSE algorithmic standardisation and its withdrawal (Mar-Aug 2020); England-focused; excludes SQA/Wales/NI parallel episodes.

incidents.title: Michigan MiDAS automated unemployment-fraud false accusations
incidents.observation_boundary: MiDAS auto-adjudication of unemployment fraud with no human review (Oct 2013-Aug 2015) and the ~40,000 false accusations; excludes broader UIA operations.

incidents.title: Raine v. OpenAI (alleged chatbot contribution to a teen suicide)
Facebook Files: Instagram engagement ranking and teen harm
incidents.observation_boundary: Instagram's engagement-based recommendation/ranking and documented teen-mental-health harms per Meta's internal 2019-2021 research and the 2021 disclosures; excludes the later Teen Accounts era.

incidents.title: Volkswagen Dieselgate emissions defeat device
incidents.observation_boundary: The 2.0L TDI defeat-device software (MY2009-2015, ~475-500k US vehicles) and its defeat of emissions testing; the 3.0L matter and non-US markets are context.

incidents.title: Racial bias in pulse-oximeter oxygen estimation
incidents.observation_boundary: Racial bias in pulse-oximeter SpO2 estimation from unrepresentative calibration (surfaced 2020) and resulting occult hypoxemia / treatment delays; focuses on the calibration and regulatory-testing failure.

incidents.title: 2010 Flash Crash (automated trading cascade)
Zillow Offers iBuying algorithmic mispricing collapse
IBM Watson for Oncology unsafe treatment recommendations
incidents.observation_boundary: The MSK-trained commercial Watson for Oncology product, its synthetic-case training and unsafe recommendations per internal 2017 documents; excludes the separate MD Anderson project.

incidents.title: Mobley v. Workday (alleged AI hiring discrimination)
incidents.observation_boundary: Allegations and rulings in Mobley v. Workday regarding AI applicant-screening and discrimination; excludes adjudicated liability (none yet).

incidents.title: Google Gemini historically inaccurate image generation (over-correction)
Tesla Autopilot fatal crash (Mountain View; Walter Huang)
NHTSA ~2M-vehicle Tesla Autopilot recall (inadequate driver engagement)
incidents.observation_boundary: NHTSA's finding (EA22-002) that Autopilot driver-engagement controls were insufficient across ~2M vehicles and the Dec 2023 recall, based on the crash set incl. stationary-emergency-vehicle collisions; excludes individual crash specifics.

incidents.title: Rotterdam welfare-fraud risk-scoring algorithm
incidents.observation_boundary: Rotterdam's gradient-boosting welfare-fraud risk-scoring model (~2017-2021; ~30,000 recipients scored, top ~1,000/yr investigated) and its discriminatory scoring; excludes other municipalities.

incidents.title: Automated essay scoring validity failure (ETS e-rater / BABEL)
incidents.observation_boundary: The construct-validity and adversarial-robustness failure of ETS e-rater automated essay scoring as demonstrated by the BABEL generator (2014) and ETS's response; focuses on e-rater, with other AES engines as context.
